correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the equilibrium shift u=x+beta,v=y,w=z and the monic characteristic cubic lambda^3+lambda^2+(1+beta)lambda+1; its Routh first column (1,1,beta,1) gives three stable roots for beta>0 and two unstable for beta<0. At beta=0 the roots are -1,+/-i and implicit differentiation gives lambda'(0)=(-1+i)/4. Independently expanded the polynomial vector-field quadratic and cubic forms and checked Aq=iq, A^T p=-ip, conjugate(p)^T q=1, h11=A^{-1}B(q,qbar)=(2alpha,0,0), the resolvent term and the real normal-form contraction: Re G/2=(8alpha^2-13alpha+15gamma-1)/20. At alpha=23/10,gamma=1/20 it equals 1217/2000. The radial normal form dot r=(-beta/4)r+l1*r^3+... gives r^2=beta/(4l1)+o(|beta|) and radial derivative beta/2. The degenerate l1=0 surface is excluded, so the claim makes no unsupported higher-order Hopf assertion.
residual_risks: Only a local bifurcation for sufficiently small beta is justified; no global cycle continuation or claim on l1=0.
